project_id.description: Required owning UUID in management writes. Configuration promotion rebinds this field from its explicit project name.

credential.description: Bearer credential; absent preserves, null removes. Never returned.

entra_client_secret.description: Replacement Entra OBO middle-tier client secret. Required when enabling Entra or changing the issuer, client ID, or token endpoint. Never returned.

consent.description: One-use consent code, shown only once and bound to the selected agent.

delegation_pair_digest.description: Stable pair budget ID for this delegation.

allowed_routes.description: Active inference routes currently allowed by both the key and the agent.

allowed_toolsets.description: Published toolsets currently allowed by both the key and the agent.

allowed_agents.description: Published agents currently allowed by both the key and the workload.

AgentRunStep.description: A step and its dispatch attempt. Remaining amounts are unresolved exposure, not charges.

tool_alias.description: Recorded tool alias, if a tool call exists.

tool_is_error.description: Whether the tool returned an error result.

pricing_state.description: Recorded tool pricing state; unpriced amounts are unknown.

AgentRunApproval.description: Approval metadata without tokens or content.

AgentRunSpan.description: Correlated span metadata without messages, arguments, results or rendered prompts.

AgentRunSpanList.description: Correlated spans, ordered by start time and ID from newest to oldest.

InvestigationFilters.description: Typed filters used to investigate agent evidence.

InvestigationEvidence.description: Reference to evidence in the investigation project. A retained reference can outlive its source evidence.

InvestigationWrite.description: Operator-authored filters, evidence references and summary. Do not submit source payloads.

run_id.description: The associated run, when this step, approval or span is still retained.

InvestigationEvidenceView.description: Reference to evidence in the investigation project. A retained reference can outlive its source evidence; the associated run is resolved on detail reads.

callback_attempts.description: Admitted callbacks, or null for tasks created before callback counts were recorded.

delegation_pair_id.description: Stable, project-scoped pair identifier, or null for an undelegated task.

A2ATaskRemoteFee.description: A remote message fee and its unresolved exposure.

A2ATaskDetail.description: Content-free task and associated remote message fees.

callback_attempts.description: Admitted callbacks, or null for tasks created before callback counts were recorded.

delegation_pair_id.description: Stable, project-scoped pair identifier, or null for an undelegated task.

AgentDelegation.description: Content-free delegation principals, revocation and pair budget.

member_authorized.description: Current authority of the consenting member, or null for key delegation.

A2ATaskModelCallback.description: Content-free callback accounting; null amounts are unknown.

A2ATaskToolCallback.description: Content-free callback accounting; null amounts are unknown.
